early_late_open_set_loss.metric: early weeks 2-3 mean open-set log loss minus late weeks 14-18 mean; positive means lower late loss

methods.concentration: Shannon entropy, HHI, and top-signature share of exact observed signatures
methods.cross_season_baselines: previous season team, all older team seasons, and all prior league seasons; action fields only
methods.early_late_test: paired 2022-25 team-season early (weeks 2-3) versus late (weeks 14-18) open-set loss; bootstrap resamples franchises
methods.novelty_expected_rate: Good-Turing singleton mass f1/N from prior team-season signatures, held as next-week first-snap estimate

open_set_forecast.interpretation: tests known-versus-unseen descriptor probability, not which unseen signature occurs
open_set_forecast.model: Dirichlet smoothing over observed exact signatures plus one aggregate unseen-signature bucket

methods.stability: Jensen-Shannon divergence in bits between weekly distributions and prior cumulative / prior observed week

stationary_playbook_null.contrast: team-season mean weeks 2-3 minus weeks 14-18; uncertainty from week-package permutations
stationary_playbook_null.curves: first-observed signature row share, JSD versus cumulative prior catalog, and JSD versus previous played week
stationary_playbook_null.preserved: each team-season pooled signature frequencies by family, number of games, per-game play counts, played-week labels, and cross-family co-occurrence
stationary_playbook_null.scope: 2022-25 action, presentation, chart-tag, and combined signatures; complete historical regular seasons
stationary_playbook_null.unit: whole team-week packages of game-level counters for all signature families jointly shuffled among that team's played weeks

methods.within_season_novelty: current week's signatures absent from the team's earlier weeks; week 1 is null for this measure

scope.row_filter: play_type IN ('run','pass') AND posteam IS NOT NULL

signature_definition.combined: nested raw-field action, presentation, and chart-tag signatures
signature_definition.cross_season: action signature only; raw participation vocabularies are not harmonized
signature_definition.missing_values: retained as null and kept distinct from absent source joins

sources.play_name_or_concept_ids: not available; signatures remain observed-field tuples
